svg.title: Red Dark Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Observed organic silhouette hand-traced from the ordinary Met page preview. Fine contour irregularities omitted; source dark blue is mapped to the shared interpretive blue palette. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for red, blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/481000; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
